about.title: Palm Desert Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Riverside County traffic records show that even with relatively few fatal crashes reported in a recent year, each one leaves a family reeling. Corridors like Fred Waring Drive, Highway 111, Country Club Drive, and Cook Street see significant traffic volume, and Thursday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. tend to show more reported collisions than other times. When a crash on one of these roads takes a family member's life, California law gives certain surviving relatives the right to pursue a wrongful death claim separate from any criminal proceeding. This is a civil action focused on the financial and emotional losses left behind. We handle wrongful death claims for families in Palm Desert, explaining standing, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable, so your family can focus on healing while the legal groundwork moves forward.

whyChoose.title: What Matters in a Wrongful Death Claim

items.title: Only Certain Relatives Can File
items.desc: California law limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain other dependents or heirs. We can clarify who in your family qualifies before any claim moves forward.

items.title: A Strict Two-Year Deadline Applies
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter window. Missing these deadlines can end a family's right to recover.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California allows families to seek funeral costs and lost financial support, along with compensation for the loss of love, companionship, and guidance — losses that are real but harder to calculate without legal guidance.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in Palm Desert?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none of these exist, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing. We can review your family's situation to confirm who qualifies.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Palm Desert?
items.answer: Generally, California allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public road agency, may be involved, the deadline to act is much shorter. Because Palm Desert's major corridors like Highway 111 and Cook Street are publicly maintained, it's worth having this checked promptly.

items.question: Does a wrongful death claim replace a criminal case against the at-fault driver?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensating the family, regardless of whether criminal charges are filed or how they're resolved. The two processes run independently and serve different purposes.
